The Golf column's activities net to (61,170.39) (operating (5,935.68), capital (145,916.50), noncapital 90,681.79) but it prints no net change and zero beginning/ending cash, so the Total net increase includes it while the Total ending cash does not.

notes: GAAP; single governmental fund (General). Governmental statement lists spending by object (p4); functions assigned from the department schedule (p14) where the label names a function, otherwise general government with review. 'Note Payment' 198,759.40 is printed under other financing uses (p5) below total expenditures: recorded as a disbursement with outside_printed_total (Statement of Activities shows it as interest expense and bond fees); identity reconciles. Intergovernmental 280,803.43 split using the General Fund revenue schedule (p13). ending_cash = county treasurer cash 4,148.25 and ending_investments = certificates of deposit 867,548.86 (governmental funds balance sheet p3); the General Fund also has a pooled cash deficit liability 1,729,160.41. Business-type = enterprise Total column (Electric, Water, Sewer, Golf, Other=Ambulance+Waste). Balance sheet = Statement of Net Position Totals column. Detail: the all-funds budgetary basis schedule (p12) is a combined schedule and is not recorded; General Fund from its revenue (p13) and departmental expenditure (p14) schedules; Ambulance and Waste from the nonmajor proprietary combining statement (p15); Electric, Water, Sewer and Golf from their proprietary statement columns (pp8-9).
